result.finding: Target container OS is Linux (Ubuntu-based via eclipse-temurin:8-jre). Management/setup scripts are available for Windows (PowerShell .ps1 files).
evidence: Dockerfile final stage: FROM eclipse-temurin:8-jre (Eclipse Temurin 8 JRE, based on Ubuntu Jammy/Focal Linux)
Dockerfile build stage: FROM maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-8 (also Ubuntu-based)
Oracle DB container: gvenzl/oracle-free:latest (supports ARM64 and x86_64 Linux)
ENTRYPOINT uses sh shell: ENTRYPOINT ["sh", "-c", "java $JAVA_OPTS -jar app.jar"] — Linux shell
azure-setup.ps1 and azure-reset.ps1 — PowerShell scripts for Windows management tasks
